newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Dev in China's malting industry.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Dev in China's malting industry.

text.p: Guangdong Development Fund Ltd said on Tuesday it spent US$14 million acquiring a 29.5 percent stake in Guangzhou Malting Co Ltd and its affilate Yangcheng Malting Co Ltd.
The investment consisted of a cash payment of approximately $11.26 million and the assumption of debt of about $2.72 million, the company said in a statement.
The company said it would receive, in proportion to its holding, the projected profit of the two malting firms for the period from January to October 1996.
It did not provide the projected 1996 profits but said the two firms had a combined net profit of 34 million yuan in 1995.
It said the two companies together have annual production capacity of 200,000 tonnes and had total production in 1995 of 91,000 tonnes.
Guangdong Investment also said it had allowed its option to invest in Guangdong Yulong Weaving and Dyeing Mill Ltd to lapse.
